candidate.answerReason: The two angle equalities and AC = DF establish congruence by AAS, so the corresponding sides EF and BC both have length 4.

methods.label: AAS and corresponding sides
methods.explanation: \(AC\) is opposite \(\angle B\), and \(DF\) is opposite \(\angle E\). By AAS, \(\triangle ABC\cong\triangle DEF\), so \(EF=BC=4\).
methods.levelReason: AAS and equality of corresponding sides are Grade 8 congruence knowledge.
